component.name: FileFlow Studio
component.summary: Visual DAG workflow engine and batch file processing automation platform

description.p: FileFlow Studio is an advanced cross-platform visual DAG (Directed Acyclic Graph) workflow workstation for automated batch file processing, OCR, AI inference, and media transcoding.

ul.li: Interactive DAG visual canvas with real-time cycle prevention and validation.
Local AI model inference (ONNX, Vision-LLM, image classification, object detection).
Integrated Script Studio with dual C# (Roslyn JIT) and JavaScript engines.
Multi-format report generation (Interactive HTML, Markdown, ASCII tree, JSON, CSV).
High-throughput concurrent pipeline processing powered by .NET 9 and Avalonia UI.

description.p: FileFlow Studio 1.0.0 - Multiplatform release with Avalonia UI, undo/redo DAG engine, high-speed startup, and native Linux Flatpak support.
